name: crucible-viewer
description: The TypeScript side of the Crucible viewer: the server's control protocol, and the wasm viewer that draws a run's frames on a canvas.

scripts.build:ts: rm -rf dist && tsc && mkdir -p dist/wasm && cp src/wasm/crucible_viewer.js src/wasm/crucible_viewer.d.ts src/wasm/crucible_viewer_bg.wasm dist/wasm/
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
